messages:
maria_sales: Quick heads-up — AcadiaBank wants a POC to replace RivalAPI. Primary asks: endpoint parity, prompt/response parity, SSO + data residency, and pricing comparability. Can we sketch plan?
aj_engineer: Yep. Proposed scope: 1) API shim mapping, 2) prompt parity harness, 3) security questionnaire + DPA check, 4) perf baseline (p95, tps). Need sample RivalAPI calls from their team.
devon_se: Also need a list of top 25 prompts they care about (customer support, KBA, policy-check). Prompt drift is where most surprises happen.
maria_sales: I asked Acadia for the sample set and their success criteria (we need parity within X% on intent/slot extraction + <20% latency delta). They asked about billing model for POC (trial credits vs invoice).
aj_engineer: For tech presales: we can offer a capped free POC instance (30k tokens/day) and a short eval on Dedicated if they want throughput. Pricing note: demo credits for POC, pricing for production follows standard reserved/dedicated tiers.
rachel_security: Re security: they require SSO (SAML), at-rest encryption keys (bring-your-own-key), and EU data residency. Also they'll send a 40-page security questionnaire. We need to confirm Private deployment timelines if on-prem required.
elaine_legal: Please have them share the questionnaire PDF to legal@redwood.com. We'll need to review DPA + any export control clauses. If they want a custom amendment, expect a 2-week review.
ben_ops: On capacity: if they test bursty workloads we should advise on autoscale + burst pools. For the POC we can provision a small Dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv) — that'll keep latency below 150ms for their typical payloads. Cost estimate attached in DM.
deploy-bot: POC env created: rdpoc-acadia-001 (region: eu-west-1) — credentials shared to @maria_sales via DM.
aj_engineer: For prompt parity harness, here's a quick run command we can share with customer to reproduce locally:
```
python run_parity_eval.py \
  --baseline-url https://api.rival.ai/v1/generate \
  --target-url https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  --prompts sample_prompts.json \
  --out diffs.json
```
aj_engineer: We should include simple heuristics: normalized semantic similarity (embedding cosine), token-level edit distance, and a binary intent match. Aim: semantic similarity > 0.88 and intent-match > 95% for pass.
devon_se: For quick adapter shim: we map RivalAPI's `POST /v1/respond` -> Redwood `POST /v1/chat` with minimal translation. Example Node snippet to shim headers + body: 
```js
// minimal shim
fetch('/v1/respond', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify(req.body)})
// translate rival.prompt -> messages array
```
maria_sales: Acadia asked if we can preserve exact top-k sampling config to match Rival outputs. Is that possible?
aj_engineer: We can surface sampling params (top_k, top_p, temp) in shim. But exact bit-for-bit match unlikely because model ops differ; we should focus on functional parity. We'll document differences and offer prompt templates.
rachel_security: Reminder: if they want logs retained, we must ensure retention policy and redaction (PII). We'll need signed confirmation for any raw logs access.
elaine_legal: Confirming: legal wants to know if customer data ever traverses US; if they need EU-only, we must lock control plane to eu region.
ben_ops: Note on SLA: for POC we do best-effort, but for Dedicated commit we can agree on 99.9% with defined remediation.
maria_sales: OK action items: 1) Aj/Dovon prepare shim + eval harness by EOW, 2) Rachel/Legal to review questionnaire once received, 3) Ops to standby for Dedicated sizing. I'll schedule POC kickoff next Tue 10am CET.
devon_se: I'll draft the shim PR and a small dockerized harness so they can run locally.
aj_engineer: Quick initial test on the sample prompts from Acadia (50 prompts) — initial parity gap ~8% on intent match, 12% on semantic sim. We'll iterate prompts and sampling.
maria_sales: Great. @elaine_legal @rachel_security please confirm availability for Tue kickoff. :thumbsup:
elaine_legal: I can join Tue.
rachel_security: In.
maria_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll post the calendar invite and forward the questionnaire when it arrives.
